source_cautions.description: The author asserts disease,poison and injury signs and exceptions for pregnancy/surgery under anesthesia. These are discredited historical claims,not implemented diagnostic rules.
The author asserts left-only heart/spleen labels and handedness/intellectual-faculty reversal. Only literal schematic organ-label placement is supported;no handedness,ability or trait inference.
Split-circle construction and claimed anatomical correspondence are historical doctrine,not proof. Fig5 is not this profile's selectable diagram.
Embedded labels serve as the selected legend. Unequal and nested fields prevent inventing equal-width polar sectors.

conventions.edition: Fifth edition1922 visually verified;copyright1919 does not make this the1919 edition. Separate from Jensen,Deck and Rayid.
conventions.orientation: Read eye names literally from upright source plate:right iris on reader left,left iris on reader right. No assumption about a patient photograph,mirror or camera transform.
conventions.identifiers: Software label/region IDs identify transcribed labels;not printed numbered sectors. Perimeter numbering retained as documentary context only.
conventions.geometry: Clock position and radial-band hints may be preserved as unsupported annotations;never used to infer a label or validate a coordinate boundary.
conventions.coverage: 33 entries across both eyes,selected from a coherent original schematic;other labels,perimeter-mark lookup,Fig5 split-circle reconstruction and complete clinical doctrine remain unsupported.

geometry.reason: No exact polar or radial boundaries verified;no coordinates infer a label.

scientific_validity.statement: Iridology is a discredited diagnostic method. Reproducing a historical iris map does not validate an iris-to-organ connection. No medical screening,diagnosis,disease risk,treatment or personal-trait inference is provided.

limitations: Iridology is a discredited diagnostic method. Reproducing a historical iris map does not validate an iris-to-organ connection. No medical screening,diagnosis,disease risk,treatment or personal-trait inference is provided.
Manual historical labels only;no patient images,medical histories,biometrics,health scores or personal-trait assessment.
33 selected labels are supported,not the complete original chart or clinical doctrine.
Source eye names describe the upright plate only;no patient,mirror,camera or image-orientation transformation.
Printed perimeter numbers are not assumed unique label IDs,equal angular sectors or calibrated clock positions.
Numeric radial boundaries,clock-based label inference and automatic sector recognition are unsupported.
Jensen,Deck and Rayid remain separate unsupported profiles;no cross-source substitutions.
Historical claims and exceptions are documentary;no disease signs,treatments or health predictions are implemented.
